node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 503): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,560.2 at t0; 500 levels a side; sizes, walls, stops, the own orders and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic; cost and clamp figures are a kit model, illustrative, PROPOSED, not a budget. No real account identifier, key or balance. The env badge reads the session environment (DEMO here), never the feed (C-2.11).
